findings.title: Dynamic code execution with a non-literal
findings.message: eval / vm.runInNewContext is called with a non-literal argument.
findings.remediation: Dynamic code execution with a non-literal. See https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/95.html

findings.title: Database connection string with inline password
findings.message: Database connection string with inline password (gues****).
findings.remediation: Rotate this credential immediately, then load it from an environment variable or a secret manager. Removing it from the code is NOT enough: it remains visible in git history.

findings.title: Database connection string with inline password
findings.message: Database connection string with inline password (pass****).
findings.remediation: Rotate this credential immediately, then load it from an environment variable or a secret manager. Removing it from the code is NOT enough: it remains visible in git history.

findings.title: Error stack leaked to the client
findings.message: err.stack is sent in a response and can leak internals.
findings.remediation: Log the stack server-side and send a generic error body to the client.

findings.title: No lockfile found
findings.message: No lockfile found; dependency vulnerabilities were not checked.
findings.remediation: Commit package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, or yarn.lock so FullShield can audit the installed tree. Exact versions pinned in package.json are still queried.
